name: Vortex
source:
At the start of the game, you are given a quiz to help determine who you will date. The plot revolves around Victoria waking up from a hangover and trying to figure out what happened between her and her love interest during last night's party. 

You and your girl posse ask around, potentially bully your classmates, or work hard to gain their trust. 

The game has as a scoring system for Victoria's ego. Should you be mean to your classmates to uphold the status quo or cave in and let them walk over you, it will factor in what type of ending you'll get.

Join Max, Chloe, Kate, Rachel and their bottom on an exciting new adventure!
